filter.title: Posterize
filter.desc: Discrete steps per channel flatten gradients into screen-print bands.

feFuncR.data-tweak-tableValues: {levels} Red levels | Output levels of the red channel; more levels give more bands

feFuncG.data-tweak-tableValues: {levels} Green levels | Output levels of the green channel

feFuncB.data-tweak-tableValues: {levels} Blue levels | Output levels of the blue channel
